text: Assumption: External synchronization is required in case of concurrency — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: External synchronization is required in case of concurrency — is this correct?
norm: external synchronization is required in case of concurrency
assumption: External synchronization is required in case of concurrency.
rationale: ReadLine is specified as 'not thread-safe' and therefore offers no instance-internal protection against concurrent access.

original.text: Annahme: Externe Synchronisation bei Nebenläufigkeit erforderlich — trifft das zu?
original.rationale: ReadLine ist als 'not thread-safe' spezifiziert, bietet also keinen instanzinternen Schutz gegen gleichzeitige Zugriffe.
